code:
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap

g=json.load(open("plp_pocket_geometry.json"))
acc=g["accsl_vs_plp"]; tom=g["tomato_vs_plp"]
ot=pd.read_csv("ortholog_catalytic_residue_table.csv").rename(columns={"Unnamed: 0":"tomato_ACS"})
gv=pd.read_csv("gnomad_ACCSL_variants.csv")

keys=["Lys395 NZ - PLP C4A","Asp358 OD2 - PLP N1","Arg403 NH1 - PLP phosphate(min)",
      "Ser394 OG - PLP phosphate(min)","Asn330 ND2 - PLP(min)","Cys243 SG - PLP(min)",
      "Tyr361 ring centroid - PLP ring centroid"]
tkeys=list(tom.keys())
def match(k):
    tail=k.split(" - ")[-1]; head=k.split()[0][:3]
    for t in tkeys:
        if t.split(" - ")[-1]==tail: return tom[t]
    return np.nan
# explicit pairing by equivalent tomato residue, taken from the stored tomato_vs_plp dict
pair={"Lys395 NZ - PLP C4A":"Lys278 NZ - PLP C4A",
      "Asp358 OD2 - PLP N1":"Asp237 OD2 - PLP N1",
      "Arg403 NH1 - PLP phosphate(min)":"Arg286 NH1 - PLP phosphate(min)",
      "Ser394 OG - PLP phosphate(min)":"Ser277 OG - PLP phosphate(min)",
      "Asn330 ND2 - PLP(min)":"Asn209 ND2 - PLP(min)",
      "Cys243 SG - PLP(min)":"Thr128 OG1 - PLP(min)",
      "Tyr361 ring centroid - PLP ring centroid":"Tyr240 ring centroid - PLP ring centroid"}
avail={k:(acc[k], tom.get(pair[k], np.nan)) for k in keys if k in acc}
print("tomato keys available:", tkeys)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(17,5.6))

# Panel A
ax=axes[0]
lab=[k.split(" - ")[0] for k in avail]; a=[v[0] for v in avail.values()]; t=[v[1] for v in avail.values()]
x=np.arange(len(lab)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,a,w,color="#2c6fbb",label="ACCSL model, transplanted PLP")
ax.bar(x+w/2,t,w,color="#aaaaaa",label="Tomato ACS 1IAX, crystal PLP")
ax.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="firebrick",lw=1)
ax.text(len(lab)-0.4,3.62,"3.5 A H-bond limit",color="firebrick",ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Distance to PLP (A)"); ax.set_title("a  PLP half-site geometry is intact in ACCSL",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

# Panel B: conservation status across mammals
cols=["human ACCSL","mouse Accsl","rat Accsl","human ACCS","mouse Accs"]
rows=ot[ot.tomato_ACS.str.contains("len|%id")==False].reset_index(drop=True)
status=np.zeros((len(rows),len(cols)))
for i,r in rows.iterrows():
    tom_aa=r.tomato_ACS.strip()[0] if r.tomato_ACS[0].isalpha() else None
    # identity to the tomato catalytic residue, by one-letter code of the tomato name
    three={"Leu":"L","Ala":"A","Asn":"N","Tyr":"Y","Arg":"R","Thr":"T","Asp":"D","Ile":"I","Ser":"S","Lys":"K","Gly":"G"}
    tok=r.tomato_ACS.split()[0]
    ref=three.get(tok[:3], tok[-1] if tok[-1].isalpha() else None)
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        aa=str(r[c])[0]
        status[i,j]= 1 if aa==ref else 0
labels=[r.tomato_ACS for _,r in rows.iterrows()]
ax=axes[1]
ax.imshow(status,cmap=ListedColormap(["#d94a3d","#3f8f4f"]),aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=1)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(labels))); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(cols,rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(labels)):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        ax.text(j,i,str(rows.iloc[i][c]),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=6.5,
                color="white")
ax.set_title("b  Green = tomato ACS catalytic residue retained",fontsize=10)

# Panel C: allele frequency of residue 529 vs fixed substitutions
ax=axes[2]
af=float(gv[gv.rsid=="rs2074051"].af.iloc[0])
bars=["Arg529\n(major allele)","Cys529\n(reference allele)","Tyr423\n(fixed, hACCS R351)","Phe272\n(fixed, tomato R157)"]
vals=[af,1-af,1.0,1.0]
cols2=["#3f8f4f","#d94a3d","#d94a3d","#d94a3d"]
ax.bar(bars,vals,color=cols2)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.015,f"{v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax.set_ylabel("Frequency in human population (gnomAD v4.1)")
ax.set_title("c  The disputed residue is a polymorphism;\nthe disabling ones are fixed",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({"panelA":avail,"rs2074051_AF":af}, open("final_figure_values.json","w"), indent=1)
print("rs2074051 AF used:", af)
